subject: Mathematics
title: Aami's Birthday
subtitle: Numbers from 10 to 20
hero_picture: A cheerful classroom birthday party: a smiling girl in a wheelchair (Aami) with a birthday cake, children decorating with balloons and paper festoons, a happy birthday banner without any letters.

sections.heading: Ten friends
text: There were 9 children. With Aami, now there are ten.
sections.caption: Getting the class ready
sections.picture: Children in a classroom tying colourful balloons and hanging paper festoons; 9 children plus one more girl joining, making 10.

sections.heading: Cards in a row
sections.caption: Birthday cards
sections.picture: Children standing in a line holding greeting cards, and a board where butterfly cards are pasted in a row.

sections.heading: Candles and cake
text: 10 and 5 make 15. Everyone gets a piece of cake!
sections.caption: Candles and cake
sections.picture: A birthday cake with candles on a table; children around it; a packet of candles with some candles outside the packet.

sections.heading: Ice cream for all
text: 10 cups in the first box, 10 in the second.
sections.caption: Ice cream cups
sections.picture: Two boxes of chocolate ice-cream cups, 10 cups in each box, on a table at a party.

sections.heading: One more bird
text: Ten little birdies on a bough.
One more joined them. Now eleven!
sections.caption: One more birdie
sections.picture: Green birds sitting on a tree branch, ten in a row, and one more bird flying in to join them.

rhyme: Ten little birdies on a bough,
Count to twenty, me and you!
activity: Make bundles of 10 sticks. Add some loose sticks and say the number: 10 and 3 make 13.
talk: How many children were there with Aami?
summary: 10 and 1 make 11 ... 10 and 10 make 20; we can count up to 20.

questions.prompt: Ten birds and one more joined. How many now?
